verdict.rationale: Logseq documents an official logseq:// quickCapture x-callback-url that can be saved as a browser bookmark to send short text and links into the graph. This is a real, first-party browser-to-notes capture flow, but the docs scope it to short text and links rather than full page or article clipping. Missing for 10: an official browser clipper extension, full-page/article content capture, highlight capture, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the bookmarklet flow.
